items.difficulty_reason: 46 行、三步：①先用「全局 hom 复形的典范映射 + 限制/扩张标量的伴随」把题面的比较映射造出来，并说明只需在阿贝尔群派生范畴里证明它是同构；②用仿射情形的拉回-推前描述把右边改写成原复形上的 derived Hom；③核对 derived sheaf Hom 在两种假设下的性质（perfect 情形或 pseudo-coherent + 底环有限 tor 维数），最后用内 Hom 的计算（Tor 无关情形）辨认两侧。承重步骤（造映射、改写、性质核对）都在 span 内；7 处引用（5 同章、2 跨章）作导航桩。

primary.label: author lemma environment with its own label lemma-affine-morphism-and-hom-out-of-perfect (no canonical tag in the snapshot tag list); statement at source lines 5422-5445

proof_spans.label: the author's own proof environment immediately following the lemma: the construction of the canonical comparison map by adjointness of restriction and extension of scalars, the rewriting of the right hand side through the pullback-pushforward equivalence, and the two cases handled by the comparison statement on the one hand and the internal Hom computation on the other (source lines 5447-5492)
